headlines.shortLinkText: Vladar stops 27 shots as Flyers top Penguins 3-0 to take commanding 2-0 lead in first-round series

headlines.description: — Kasperi Kapanen scored his second goal of the game with 1:54 left in the third period to give the Edmonton Oilers a 4-3 victory over the Anaheim Ducks in the opener of their first-round playoff series Monday night.
